2026年1月至9月，马来西亚市场正式上市 / 正式定价的乘用车型合集，共 76: A collection of passenger car models officially launched / officially priced in the Malaysian market from January to September 2026, 76 models in total.
BYD 大马在国庆季为 Atto 3 Premium 追加一款名为 Gemila: For the Merdeka season, BYD Malaysia has added a new exterior colour called Gemilang Blue to the Atto 3 Premium — it is in fact the signature Iris Blue of the European-market Atto 3 Evo, renamed locally as a nod to Jalur Gemilang, the national flag's nickname. The new colour is offered only on the RWD Premium, and it is not a limited edition — it will remain available after the promotion ends. The real highlight is the price: the Premium now carries a Merdeka promo price of RM124,800, RM14,000 below the original RM138,800 — a discount that exactly matches the value of the launch package offered when the minor facelift went on sale in June, effectively folding the launch incentives straight into the sticker price; the FWD Ultra is reportedly enjoying a similarly sized discount right now.
Honda Malaysia 为登场三年的 WR-V 带来首次年度更新，车系同时: Honda Malaysia has given the three-year-old WR-V its first annual update, while streamlining the line-up from four variants to three — the entry-level S is discontinued, leaving the E, V and RS priced at RM94,900, RM98,900 and RM104,900 respectively (on-the-road price excluding insurance). Notably, all three variants are RM1,000 to RM3,000 cheaper than their counterparts at the July 2023 debut — a rare counter-cyclical move in a year when prices have generally been trending upward. Since its Malaysian debut in July 2023, the WR-V has accumulated over 24,000 units sold, making it one of the steadier volume drivers in Honda's local line-up.
Jaecoo 大马为今年 4 月上市的 J5 追加纯电版本，单一规格售价 RM1: Jaecoo Malaysia has added an electric version of the J5, which went on sale in April this year. The single variant is priced at RM118,800 (on-the-road price excluding insurance), RM10,000 above the petrol version's RM108,000. Like the petrol model, the EV is locally assembled (CKD) at Chery Corporate Malaysia's Shah Alam plant. The first 1,000 buyers (until 31 October) receive a launch package worth about RM10,000, including one year of unlimited free JomCharge charging, one year of free insurance, three years of free data, a 7kW home wallbox, a V2L adapter, plus accessories such as a karaoke set, a subwoofer, a torchlight and a pet carrier. Visually, the EV replaces the petrol version's large waterfall grille with a closed-off design and adds an active grille shutter. Worth noting: the same model sells for about RM70,491 in Indonesia and about RM81,230 in Thailand, so the local price is noticeably higher.
Mitsubishi Motors Malaysia 为最入门的 Triton: Mitsubishi Motors Malaysia has added an automatic variant to the entry-level Triton Single Cab work pickup, priced at RM107,980 (private registration in Peninsular Malaysia, on-the-road price excluding insurance), RM3,000 above the existing manual. This is the first time the model — aimed primarily at fleet, construction, agriculture and forestry duties — has offered an automatic, a practical fill-in for fleet customers doing frequent stop-and-go urban driving who would rather not have their drivers working the clutch all day. A limited-time RM4,000 diesel subsidy incentive is available during the launch period; Solid White is the only colour offered, and the warranty is 5 years / 200,000 km.
Night Package 的内容包括：亮黑处理的 Mercedes-Benz: The Night Package adds high-gloss black treatment to the Mercedes-Benz-pattern grille, cooling vents, side sill trim, window surrounds, mirror caps, rear bumper and diffuser; the door handles switch to dark chrome; and the wheels are 20-inch AMG multi-spoke alloys in black. The powertrain is a 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine (204PS / 320Nm) paired with a 129PS / 440Nm electric motor for a combined 313PS / 550Nm, driving through a 9-speed automatic and 4Matic AWD, with WLTP EV range of over 100 km. Equipment matches the standard version, including Digital Light headlamps with Adaptive Highbeam Assist Plus, Artico leather upholstery, a 15-speaker Burmester audio system, seven airbags, and the Driving Assistance Package Plus (with stop-and-go adaptive cruise control, lane centring and cross-traffic warning with automatic braking).
PPE平台纯电Cayenne，113kWh电池，Turbo弹射1,156PS，破: PPE-platform electric Cayenne with a 113kWh battery; the Turbo delivers 1,156PS on launch control and does 0-100 in 2.5s.
Premium后驱版新增国庆蓝车色，特惠价较原价低RM14,000。: The RWD Premium gains the new Merdeka Blue colour, with the promo price RM14,000 below the original list.
Volvo Car Malaysia 把纯电旗舰七人座 EX90 转为本地组装（: Volvo Car Malaysia has switched the electric flagship seven-seater EX90 to local assembly (CKD), replacing the China-imported CBU version introduced in April 2025. The single Twin Motor Performance variant is priced at RM428,888 (on-the-road price excluding insurance), RM14,000 below the previous CBU; the first 100 buyers additionally receive a RM25,000 cash rebate and a Volvo wallbox charger worth RM3,990. Only the 2-3-2 seven-seat layout is available for now, with the 2-2-2 six-seater to follow later.

与 EX90 同日发表，Volvo Car Malaysia 也为纯电轿车 ES: Announced the same day as the EX90, Volvo Car Malaysia has also given the electric ES90 sedan a MY2027 update, with pricing unchanged at RM339,888 (on-the-road price excluding insurance) — identical to the previous model year. The updates focus on the interior and exterior: the cabin moves from the previous Nordico synthetic leather to Nappa leather in Charcoal and the newly added Cardamom, paired with birch wood trim; the wheels shrink from 22-inch to a 21-inch diamond-cut five-spoke design — and the smaller size actually adds 11 km of WLTP range, taking it to 662 km. New colours are Mulberry Red and Aurora Silver, while Denim Blue is discontinued; connectivity gains wireless Android Auto alongside the existing wireless Apple CarPlay.
严格来说这还不是一场上市发布，而是 Mazda 与大马投资发展局（MIDA）联合: Strictly speaking this is not a launch event but an industry announcement jointly confirmed by Mazda and the Malaysian Investment Development Authority (MIDA): the all-new third-generation CX-5 will switch to local assembly (CKD) in Malaysia, with a localisation target of 60%. The new model will first go on sale as a fully-imported (CBU) offering on 8 October, with CKD production expected to begin in 12 to 16 months. Under the MIDA–Mazda strategic supplier development programme, 16 local automotive parts suppliers are already on board, spanning chassis and suspension, stamping, precision machining, plastic injection moulding, cabin modules, seating systems and sound insulation, along with five memoranda of cooperation signed between Malaysian and Japanese companies at the same time. Official pricing has yet to be announced; the market estimates a starting price of around RM170,000.
六个版本全数採双电机四驱。入门 Cayenne 输出 408PS（弹射模式 44: All six variants use dual-motor AWD. The entry Cayenne delivers 408PS (442PS on launch control) / 835Nm, does 0-100 in 4.8s, top speed 230km/h; the Cayenne S offers 544PS (666PS on launch control) / 1,080Nm, 0-100 in 3.8s, top speed 250km/h; and the Turbo produces 857PS (1,156PS on launch control) / 1,500Nm with 0-100km/h in just 2.5s, 0-200km/h in 7.4s and a 260km/h top speed. The entire range shares a 113kWh NMC battery and 800-volt electrical architecture, with WLTP range between 624 and 669 km (the Coupé actually goes further thanks to its lower drag); DC fast-charging peaks at 390kW and up to 400kW under ideal conditions, taking under 16 minutes for 10-80%, while AC charging is 11kW standard (22kW optional), plus an optional factory 11kW wireless charger. Dimensions are 4,985 × 1,980 × 1,674 mm (the Coupé is 1,650 mm tall), with a 3,023 mm wheelbase — 128 mm longer than the petrol version — a drag coefficient of 0.25 (0.23 for the Coupé) and a kerb weight of about 2.6 tonnes. Air suspension and PASM adaptive dampers are standard across the range; the options list includes PTV Plus rear differential, rear-axle steering of up to 5 degrees, carbon-ceramic brakes and the Porsche Active Ride active suspension, with regenerative braking of up to 600kW. Inside there is a 14.25-inch curved OLED instrument display, a Flow Display angled central touchscreen, an optional 14.9-inch passenger display, an AR head-up display with an equivalent 87-inch field of view, and wireless CarPlay/Android Auto, while physical climate and volume controls are retained; the boot holds 781 litres (584 litres for the Coupé) plus a 90-litre frunk, with ground clearance of 245 mm when raised and a 550 mm wading depth.
动力为前置单电机，输出 155kW（211PS）/ 288Nm，0–100km/: Power comes from a front-mounted single motor producing 155kW (211PS) / 288Nm, with 0-100km/h in 7.7s and a 175km/h top speed. The battery is a CATL-supplied 58.9kWh LFP pack delivering 402 km WLTP and 461 km NEDC — larger than the Thai version's 50.6kWh but smaller than the Indonesian version's 60.9kWh. DC fast-charging peaks at 130kW with 30-80% taking 28 minutes; AC charging is 11kW with 10-100% in about 7 hours; and 3.3kW V2L output is supported. Dimensions are 4,380 × 1,860 mm with a 2,620 mm wheelbase and 174 mm ground clearance; the boot holds 480 litres (1,284 litres with the rear seats folded) plus a 35-litre frunk, and there is no spare tyre. Equipment includes an 8.88-inch digital instrument cluster, a 13.2-inch portrait central screen, ventilated power front seats, a 1.45-metre panoramic glass roof (with power sunshade), dual-zone climate control, wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay, 50W wireless charging, a 540-degree view monitor, a power tailgate, double-laminated acoustic front glass, heated mirrors with memory, plus in-car karaoke and pet and camping climate modes. Safety comprises six airbags and Level 2+ driver assistance (including AEB, lane departure warning and keeping, blind spot detection, ACC and more). The wheels are 18-inch two-tone aero designs on 235/55 Giti tyres, with colours Alpine Green, Fjord Grey and Carbon Crystal Black. The warranty is 7 years / 150,000 km for the vehicle and 10 years / 200,000 km for the battery.
动力延续 2.4 升涡轮柴油四缸，输出 184PS / 430Nm，新增的六速自: The 2.4-litre turbodiesel four-cylinder carries over with 184PS / 430Nm, and the new six-speed automatic shares its gearing with the manual; drive goes through the Easy Select part-time 4WD system with 2H, 4H and 4L modes, plus a standard rear-axle differential lock — uncommon among work pickups at this price point. Payload is 1,145 kg, the cargo bed measures 2,340 × 1,580 × 515 mm, and the tyres are 265/65 all-terrains on 17-inch steel wheels. Equipment-wise, the automatic variant alone adds reverse sensors, while the rest matches the manual: a bed liner, black rear bumper, black vinyl seats, automatic headlamps and wipers, black door handles, and three airbags including a driver's knee airbag.
动力维持 1.5 升自然进气 i-VTEC 四缸 DOHC 引擎，121PS（6: The 1.5-litre naturally-aspirated i-VTEC four-cylinder DOHC engine carries over with 121PS (at 6,600 rpm) / 145Nm (at 4,300 rpm), paired with a CVT and FWD, doing 0-100km/h in about 11 to 11.2 seconds with a 160km/h top speed. The facelift focuses on the cabin: the central screen upgrades from a 7-inch unit to a 10-inch Display Audio head unit, with wireless Android Auto and Apple CarPlay across the range; the RS further adds a 360-degree camera, a wireless charging pad, red ambient lighting and a full-black grille, and the whole range moves to 17-inch black alloys on 215/55R17 tyres. Inside, Dark Steel trim panels are fitted; the V and RS upgrade to full leather seats (blue contrast stitching for the V, red for the RS); the E gets manual air conditioning while the V and RS get single-zone climate control. On safety, Honda Sensing is standard across the range, covering forward collision warning with AEB, lane keeping assist, lane departure warning, road departure mitigation, adaptive cruise control, automatic high beam and lead-car departure alert, plus LaneWatch passenger-side blind spot camera; airbags range from 4 to 6 depending on variant, alongside VSA, ABS, EBD and hill start assist. New colours include Blazing Red Pearl (replacing Ignite Red Metallic), with the RS also offering a red-with-black-roof two-tone option, while Crystal Black Pearl is discontinued. The warranty is 5 years with unlimited mileage, plus 5 labour-free service visits within 5 years or 100,000 km.

机械规格不变，仍为单一 Ultra Single Motor Extended: The mechanical specification is unchanged — still the single Ultra Single Motor Extended Range variant, with a rear-mounted motor producing 245kW (333PS) / 480Nm, 0-100km/h in 6.6s and an electronically limited 180km/h top speed. The battery is a 92kWh NCM pack; DC fast-charging peaks at 350kW with 10-80% in 22 minutes, and AC charging is 11kW with 0-100% in 10 hours; the car is likewise locally assembled (CKD). Volvo is additionally offering a cash rebate of up to RM17,600, which together with the RM3,990 wallbox charger brings the total incentive value to RM21,590.
机械规格与 6 月小改款上市时完全相同：Premium 搬来欧洲 Evo 版规格: The mechanical specification is exactly as it was when the minor facelift launched in June: the Premium adopts the European Evo version's hardware, moving to a rear-mounted motor producing 230kW (313PS) / 380Nm, with 0-100km/h in 5.5s and a 180km/h top speed; the battery is a 74.88kWh blade LFP pack delivering 510 km WLTP, and the 800-volt architecture supports 220kW DC fast-charging (10-80% in about 25 minutes) and 11kW AC charging (about 8 hours for a full charge). Suspension is double-ball-joint MacPherson up front with a five-link rear axle, and the warranty remains 6 years / 150,000 km for the vehicle plus 8 years / 160,000 km for the battery and drive unit. At the promo price of RM124,800, this RWD Atto 3 now sits right in the territory the FWD Ultra used to occupy — the most significant value shift of this Merdeka promotion.
确认本地组装、本地化率60%；先CBU後CKD，10月8日正式发布。: Local assembly confirmed with 60% localisation; CBU first, CKD to follow; official launch on 8 October.
第三代 CX-5 车身尺寸为 4,690 × 1,860 × 1,695 毫米，: The third-generation CX-5 measures 4,690 × 1,860 × 1,695 mm with a 2,815 mm wheelbase — 115 mm longer, 15 mm wider and 15 mm taller than its predecessor. Power comes from a 2.5-litre e-Skyactiv G naturally-aspirated four-cylinder petrol engine with a 24-volt mild-hybrid system, producing 141PS / 238Nm and driving through a six-speed Skyactiv-Drive automatic to the front wheels (no AWD variant mentioned so far). The cabin's biggest change is wholesale digitalisation: the centre console offers a 12.9-inch or 15.6-inch touchscreen (the Malaysian show car has the 15.6-inch), running Android Automotive OS, plus a wireless charging pad; the trade-off is that Mazda's long-serving Commander rotary controller and most physical buttons are gone. Full specifications and pricing will be revealed at the official launch on 8 October.
继今年 6 月的 GLA Nightfall 与 7 月的 AMG GLC43: Following the GLA Nightfall in June and the AMG GLC43 Nightfall in July this year, Mercedes-Benz Malaysia has now introduced a Nightfall Edition of the GLC350e 4Matic Coupé plug-in hybrid coupe-SUV, priced at RM442,888 (on-the-road price excluding insurance) — RM17,000 above the standard version's RM425,888. Like the previous two, the Nightfall is a purely appearance-oriented package variant with mechanical specification identical to the standard version, likewise locally assembled (CKD) at the Pekan plant in Pahang.
继今年 6 月的本地预览之後，Porsche 大马代理 Sime Darby A: Following June's local preview, Porsche's Malaysian distributor Sime Darby Auto Performance has officially announced pricing for the electric Cayenne and put it on sale. It is the brand's third production EV after the Taycan and Macan Electric, and the first time the Cayenne line-up runs petrol and electric side by side — the locally-assembled (CKD) petrol and S E-Hybrid plug-in hybrid versions remain on sale (from RM609,000 for the standard version), while the EV is introduced as a fully-imported (CBU) offering in six variants launched at once: Cayenne, Cayenne S and Cayenne Turbo in both standard-body and Coupé forms. Net prices: the entry Cayenne is RM699,000 and the Coupé RM749,000; the Cayenne S is RM759,000 and RM805,000; and the range-topping Turbo comes in at RM969,999 and RM999,999. The new model is based on the PPE electric platform co-developed with Audi, debuted globally in November 2025, and has reached Malaysia in under a year.
莎阿南本地组装纯电版，58.9kWh电池，WLTP续航402公里。: Locally-assembled (Shah Alam) electric version with a 58.9kWh battery; 402 km WLTP range.
这次换代最大的技术变动是电气架构由 400 伏特升级为 800 伏特。双电机（前: The biggest technical change of this update is the electrical architecture moving from 400 volts to 800 volts. The dual motors (one per axle) produce 680PS (500kW) / 870Nm — 40Nm less than before — with 0-100km/h in 4.2s and a 180km/h top speed. Battery capacity drops from 111kWh gross / 107kWh net to 106kWh gross / 103kWh net (NCM chemistry), nudging WLTP range down to 617 km (from 623 km); but charging speeds improve substantially — DC fast-charging rises from 250kW to 350kW, cutting the 10-80% session from 30 to 22 minutes, with a 10-minute stop adding about 250 km of range (previously 180 km), while AC charging remains 11kW with 0-100% in 10 hours. The computing platform uses dual Nvidia Drive AGX Orin chips totalling 500 TOPS with OTA update support; however, the CKD version drops the roof-mounted LiDAR sensor. Inside there is a 14.5-inch portrait touchscreen (with Google Maps, voice assistant and Play Store built in, and Android Auto and CarPlay compatibility), a 9-inch digital instrument cluster and a 25-speaker Bowers & Wilkins audio system, plus a head-up display, Digital Key Plus (replacing the conventional key with a card/tag), 21-inch eight-spoke aero wheels, active air suspension, four-zone climate control across three rows, ventilated and massaging power front seats, one-pedal driving, a power tailgate and an electrochromic glass roof. Safety includes Pilot Assist, blind spot detection, AEB, intersection automatic braking, lane keeping, rear cross-traffic warning, a 360-degree camera and Park Pilot Assist; airbags cover dual front, side, centre, curtain and driver's knee, and the ISOFIX seats integrate booster cushions. New colour: Mulberry Red; the cabin offers two Nappa leather themes — Charcoal with light ash and Cardamom with brown ash — replacing the previous Nordico leather with birch trim. The warranty is 5 years with unlimited mileage and 8 years / 160,000 km for the battery.
